jurisdiction.name: Democratic People's Republic of Korea
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: No official North Korean AI law, strategy, regulator guidance or ministry document has been found as published text. The main state portals were checked directly and carry no such document; AI appears only in leadership statements reported by state media, such as remarks in 2025 describing AI as a priority for military drones.
narrative.review_notes: The main state portals were checked directly in October 2026 and no published AI law, strategy or guidance was found; North Korean ministries, the legislature and regulators do not publish their own documents online, so the finding rests on the state portals and searches.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Official sources of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea were searched in Korean and English for laws, government strategies, ministry documents and regulator guidance on AI, and no qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The main state portals were checked directly and carry no published AI document.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp returned HTTP 503 to curl and WebFetch on every attempt; searches in Korean and English found no official AI text. Not a party to Convention 108. Units covered: Law: searched, nothing found: no official DPRK law, decree or Supreme People's Assembly (Standing Committee) decision on AI or with explicit AI provisions located; no accessible official gazette; official state portals kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp unreachable (curl and WebFetch both failed); Government: searched, nothing found: no published national AI strategy, programme or governance framework; only state-media reports of leadership statements (e.g. September 2025 remarks prioritising AI for military unmanned systems), which are not policy documents; Ministries: searched, nothing found: no ministry-level AI documents (education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour, interior, State Commission of Science and Technology) published online; Regulators: searched, nothing found: no data protection authority, cyber security agency or sector regulator publishing AI guidance exists in accessible form. Not reached: kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp (official state portals) could not be reached directly; the absence finding rests on web search plus failed direct access. Could not verify: kcna.kp and naenara.com.kp returned HTTP 503 via curl and WebFetch. binding-law, strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, data-privacy, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, international, historical: no material found. Local retry 2026-10-18 (home connection, Saudi Arabia, about 20-minute time box): kcna.kp/kp opened via curl (HTTP 200; front page only; KCNA is a news agency and cannot be a source; site search and document-section URLs tried returned 404). naenara.com.kp/main/index/ko/first timed out via curl but opened via headless browser (HTTP 200; general portal with news, country overview, economy, culture; no laws or policy documents section with AI material seen). rodong.rep.kp is a newspaper and not a source (attempted only as a check). No ministry, gazette, SPA, data-protection, cyber, standards, procurement or central-bank websites exist in accessible form. Web searches in Korean and English found no DPRK AI law or official document. Verdict: main official portals reachable; no change to findings.
